original_test_intent: Verify the Type 7 Current SRAM Type raw bitmask for each cache instance reports the approved active SRAM implementation mode(s), uses defined/reserved bits correctly, is compatible with the Supported SRAM Type mask and persists after reboot.
original_method: Capture complete raw/decoded Type 7 records, retain current and supported UINT16 masks per handle/level, decode defined bits under the applicable SMBIOS table, validate the approved current set and supported-set relationship, reboot and repeat.
manual_activity: A user approves current SRAM sets, bit definitions, supported-set relationship, unknown/other policy and reboot plan. Bitmask validation is automatable.
required_inputs: Expected Current SRAM Type bitset per Type 7 handle/level
Applicable SMBIOS defined/reserved bits and policy for Other/Unknown/zero/multiple bits
Supported SRAM Type mask and exact compatibility rule
Validated raw/decoded parser plus approved reboot and OOB recovery plan
safety_requirements: Read SMBIOS only; do not change cache technology, operational mode, CPU settings or firmware.
Preserve raw current and supported masks with handle/level; decoded text alone can hide reserved bits or parser normalization.
Require all defined current technology bits to satisfy the approved supported-mask relationship; do not assume exactly one bit unless the applicable policy requires it.
Do not infer current SRAM technology from OS cache type, associativity or latency data.
Stop on unsupported/reserved current bits, ambiguous Unknown/Other policy, drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect/decode Current SRAM Type per cache, preserve unknown bits, validate approved values and relationship to Supported SRAM Type before/after reboot.
Do not change cache modes, guess physical technology or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve current/supported bitsets, compatibility and Unknown/Other/multiple-bit rules.
Approve reboot/recovery and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is correct, but grep loses raw mask and cache identity and cannot prove reserved-bit correctness or current-versus-supported compatibility.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete Type 7 raw/decoded records and compare raw Current and Supported SRAM masks per handle using a version-aware bit decoder.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Current SRAM Type scope, Type 7 script and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Decode the raw current mask with approved SMBIOS definitions, preserve reserved/unknown bits and verify its defined technology set against the supported mask and per-cache baseline before and after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS, CPU/cache design and parser/dmidecode versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 7 Current and Supported SRAM Type bit definitions, approved cache documentation and installed tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw bitset provenance, supported-set compatibility and explicit multiple/unknown handling.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction; reveals internally contradictory technology metadata hidden by label-only output.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The historical SRAM categories are firmware metadata and may not uniquely describe a modern on-die cache implementation.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve multiple current bits or Unknown/Other for a specific cache implementation, but must document the exact raw set and how it relates to supported capabilities.
expected_evidence: Approved current/supported SRAM matrix, bit definitions, reserved/unknown policy and tool versions
Complete pre-reboot Type 7 table with handle/level and raw/decoded current and supported masks
Per-cache compatibility/subset result with any multiple-bit rationale
Approved reboot/health evidence and equivalent post-reboot comparison
Engineer verdict with disposition of any Unknown/Other/reserved bit

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The source clearly targets a defined Type 7 current-type mask; the expected bitset is a project input.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The masks are safely readable and their relationship is machine-checkable after policy is supplied.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds raw mask, cache identity, reserved-bit evidence and supported-set compatibility.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Keeps the correct cross-field check while correcting capability to FULLY AUTOMATABLE and avoiding an unsupported single-bit assumption.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Preserves current-versus-capability distinction and rejects OS cache attributes as a substitute.

review_improvement: Detects a plausible current label that is not advertised by the same record's supported mask and keeps ambiguous legacy categories explicit.
independent_technical_reasoning: Once bit definitions and current/supported policy are approved, raw extraction, decoding, relationship checks and reboot comparison are deterministic software operations.
